description: Convert a subtitle file between SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt), optionally shifting every cue by a fixed number of seconds to resync it. The source format is auto-detected. Converting WebVTT to SRT drops cue identifiers, cue settings, and NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks, since SubRip has no equivalent; every drop is reported as a warning.

input.description: The full SRT or WebVTT file contents

offsetSeconds.description: Shift every cue by this many seconds (may be negative; results below zero are clamped to 00:00:00)

name: convert_subtitles
